name: Deed intake

facts.ask: the selling party or parties, as named in the agreement (full names as written)
the buying party or parties (full names as written)
the property sold: its address and description
the cadastral identification of the property: municipality, division, section, number
the advance or guarantee paid at signing, and to whom it was paid
the date the private agreement was signed
the date by which the notarial deed must be signed
the suspensive conditions (financing, permits, other), each with its term
the seller's title: the earlier deed, its date and the notary who passed it
the energy performance certificate: its reference and result
the soil certificate: its reference and conclusion
the occupancy at delivery: free, let or occupied, and by whom

instructions:
You are preparing the intake of a sale for a notarial deed. Read the excerpts and fill in the table below: one row per fact, in this order, with the fact's id in the first column exactly as given, the value in the second column, copied as the documents write it (names, amounts, dates, references), and in the third column the excerpt numbers the value comes from, as [n]. A fact the excerpts do not contain gets an empty second column and an empty third column: never guess, never fill in from general knowledge. Answer with the table only, no text before or after it, in the language of the documents.
